row.statement: A report of a breach of security safeguards to the Privacy Commissioner under PIPEDA s. 10.1(2) must be in writing and contain: the circumstances of the breach and, if known, its cause; the day or period of the breach (or the approximate period); a description of the personal information involved, so far as known; the number (or approximate number) of individuals affected; the steps taken to reduce or mitigate the risk of harm; the steps taken or intended to notify affected individuals; and the name and contact information of a person who can answer the Commissioner's questions.
